new_spec_kit_contract: Every new Spec Kit must contain a current work-map-integration.json generated from the repository Work Maps and coverage matrix.
implementation_contract: When a PR changes implementation or repository-governance surfaces, all targeted Work Map, schema-domain, and taxonomy-gap decisions must be resolved and implementation_readiness.status must be ready.
legacy_behavior: Existing Spec Kits without a work-map-integration.json remain grandfathered until they opt in. New Spec Kits are never grandfathered.
